scope.established: Assuming the candidate package models the failure incidence over a base B as a relative P^2 inside the 21-dimensional M_{6,6} and uses expected determinantal codimension 6, its excess equals 6-(21-(dim B+2))=dim B-13. Thus excess=2 is equivalent to the unproved input dim B=15. Since deg L=6 on a genus-6 curve, chi(L)=1, and on the h^0(L)=3 stratum Riemann-Roch gives h^1(L)=2=dim|L|. Consequently the equality excess=h^1(L)=2 supplies no independent corroboration of dimension 15 or actual codimension 4. For balanced splitting F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), Lemma 10.6 gives deg W_5=16; hence h^0(W_5)=11 and evaluation on a length-six divisor has target dimension 6. After the W_4 summand is eliminated by the relevant cohomology vanishing, failure is the rank-at-most-5 locus of this 11-to-6 map, whose expected codimension is (11-5)(6-5)=6. The competing factorization 3 times 2=6 does not identify this presentation.
